// PROBE FIXTURE — lib/services/policy.service.ts as it stood before commits
// 1057ab7d / 9e6e2e12 (feat(privacy): the user's file name is kept nowhere):
// the user's own file name written straight into Prisma via the ES6 SHORTHAND,
// which the first version of the guard could not see (it matched only
// `fileName: <expr>`). tests/unit/filename-never-persisted.test.ts must stay
// red on this shape forever. Suffix .txt so no compiler, linter or test glob
// picks it up as source.
export async function createWithDocuments(tx: Tx, created: Policy, data: CreateInput) {
    if (data.documents && data.documents.length > 0) {
        for (const doc of data.documents) {
            const rawFileName = doc.name || 'Document'
            const fileName = rawFileName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_')

            await tx.policyDocument.create({
                data: {
                    policyId: created.id,
                    fileUrl: doc.url,
                    fileName,
                    fileSize: doc.size,
                    source: 'policyholder',
                },
            })
        }
    }
}
